subject.title: feat: apply messages.responsePrefix to message tool outbound sends

question: Should agent-originated `message(action="send")` deliveries receive selected provider/model/thinking context for `messages.responsePrefix` templates, or should tool sends remain static/identity-only?
rationale: Current main deliberately skips unresolved dynamic prefixes because the message-tool send path does not perform model selection; completing the request requires choosing the runtime contract and owner boundary.

options.title: Thread Run Context Into Sends
options.body: Apply dynamic responsePrefix templates for agent-originated message-tool sends using the actual selected provider, model, full model ref, and thinking level, while keeping unresolved-template skipping for sends without run context.

options.title: Document Static/Identity Only
options.body: Keep current behavior and document that message-tool sends support only static and identity prefixes unless a later design adds run-context plumbing.

options.title: Split A Design Tracker
options.body: Open or nominate a narrower design issue for selected-model prefix parity if maintainers want to close the partially fixed umbrella later.

recommendation.title: Thread Run Context Into Sends
recommendation.body: Apply dynamic responsePrefix templates for agent-originated message-tool sends using the actual selected provider, model, full model ref, and thinking level, while keeping unresolved-template skipping for sends without run context.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining question crosses message routing, reply-prefix context, and product behavior boundaries where recent history points to steipete as the strongest available routing owner.
